theorem.statement: A platform Evidence bundle is admissible only when all security-relevant artifacts are bound to one capture session, one boot identity, one TPM identity, one PCR selection, one challenge nonce, one tool/profile snapshot, and one event-log reconstruction result.

manifest_bindings.session_binding: Every required artifact digest is interpreted in the context of the same session_id and boot_id.
manifest_bindings.canonical_json: Manifest semantic hashing uses UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and no insignificant whitespace.

coherence_rules.rule: The selected TPM device path and observed TPM properties digest must remain constant throughout the capture.
The boot_id must be captured from the same operating-system boot that owns the event log and PCR observations.
The binary event-log digest must exactly match the digest referenced by the reconstruction result.
The quote PCR selection must exactly equal the declared reconstruction PCR selection and the live PCR observation selection.
The quote qualifying data must equal the fresh verifier challenge byte-for-byte; only its SHA-256 digest is carried in the manifest.
The post-quote PCR observation must be the input supplied to tpm2_checkquote so the verifier checks equality against the quoted PCR values.
Quote cryptographic verification and event-log reconstruction are separate observations and neither silently implies the other.
Event-log reconstruction PASS is required before a platform-measurement claim can be classified as PASS.
Unavailable trusted time, unavailable reconstruction, or other ambiguous external observation produces INDETERMINATE, never PASS.
Reference-value rollback or profile substitution produces DENY.

self_test.purpose: Run deterministic semantic coherence vectors without a TPM. This does not establish hardware or measured-boot security.

verify.purpose: Verify an existing capture-session bundle and cryptographically check the TPM Quote when tpm2_checkquote is available.

capture.purpose: Capture raw physical TPM/PC-client artifacts when a compatible Linux TPM device and toolchain exist. The capture is not a PASS unless all external inputs, including reconstruction and trusted time, are coherently bound.

capture_requirements.workload_pcr_note: PCR16 remains available for workload-specific evidence but is not treated as a PC-client firmware event-log PCR by this profile.

reference_boundary.event_log_semantics: The PC-client event log is evidence for reconstructing PCR state; it is not trusted merely because it parses.
reference_boundary.reference_values: Reference values are an independent appraisal input identified by version and digest.
reference_boundary.trusted_time: Trusted time is consumed as an externally qualified evidence object; local wall-clock output is not authoritative.
reference_boundary.authorization: A coherent platform Evidence bundle remains evidence only. Resource authorization is evaluated by the downstream RATS/Relying-Party/PEP chain.
